analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 22.3으로 과매도 구간 지속, ADX 52.5로 과열된 추세 경계 구간 진입. 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 $0.05로 동일하나, 5일 고가($0.06)가 20일 고가($0.08) 하회하며 Lower High 패턴 형성. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 1.80배로 급증했으나, 추세 전환 신호는 미약한 상황.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI at 22.3 continues in oversold territory, and ADX at 52.5 enters an overheated trend boundary zone. While the 5-day low and 20-day low are identical at $0.05, the 5-day high ($0.06) is below the 20-day high ($0.08), forming a Lower High pattern. Volume surged 1.80x the 5-day average, but trend reversal signals remain weak.

analysis.narrative:

· 현재가($0.05) vs SMA5($0.06)/SMA20($0.07)/SMA50($0.08): 단기·중기 추세 하회, 약세 위치 진단
· SMA100($0.08)/SMA200($0.08) 대비 위치: 중장기 추세 하회, 약세 강도 유지
· 52주 위치(1.9%) + 현 가격대 52주 최저가 부근 역사적 의미
[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0010→-0.0008): 개선 중, 약세 수렴 신호

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($0.05): 52주 최저가 및 볼린저 하단 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.07): SMA20 및 피벗 R1 기반, 돌파 시 단기 반등 기대
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low 미형성, Lower High 형성): 추세 약화 신호
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.80배): 5일 평균 대비 급증, 움직임에 힘 실림
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 과매도 지속 및 Lower High 패턴으로 인해 관망 유지, $0.07 저항 돌파 시 매수 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.05) vs SMA5 ($0.06)/SMA20 ($0.07)/SMA50 ($0.08): trading below short-term and mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($0.08)/SMA200 ($0.08): trading below long-term trends, maintaining strong weakness.
· 52-week position (1.9%) + current price level near 52-week low holds historical significance.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (26.0→22.3): remaining in oversold territory, maintaining bearish momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0010→-0.0008): improving, signaling bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $0.05): approaching the lower band, with a band width of 43.42% indicating potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.05): based on 52-week low and Bollinger lower band.
· Swing Resistance ($0.07): based on SMA20 and Pivot R1; a breakout could signal a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not formed, Lower High formed): indicating trend weakening.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.80x): surged compared to the 5-day average, adding conviction to the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to continued RSI oversold conditions and Lower High pattern; consider buying on a breakout above $0.07 resistance.
